user_instruction: NQ判官已经在跑了 开始吧 (FEVER plan: FEVER-train research set, sentence-level oracle, C0/C1/L1/L3/L4, compare with NQ)
question: For the same fixed Qwen2.5-7B, does the reach of external RAG compensation differ between FEVER and NQ: which C1 failures do real retrieval fix, which only oracle evidence fixes, and which stay wrong?
role: research measurement only. Not a FEVER product evaluation; the product is NQ-only. Results are reported as the FEVER SUPPORTS/REFUTES subset, never as the three-class FEVER score.

team_test.name: fever_dev 13,332 SUPPORTS/REFUTES claims (feature/baseline-evaluation e8c4213, frozen FEVER Test)
team_test.untouched: no run of this protocol reads or runs a Test claim
team_test.history: the 2026-10 FEVER C1 (900) and preliminary C0/C3 (500) items all lie inside this Test; earlier FEVER numbers are Test exposures

eligibility: every annotated evidence sentence (union over evidence groups) resolves to non-empty text in the FEVER wiki dump
every evidence page has text (so it is a corpus passage)
normalized claim not equal to a team Test claim, and token Jaccard < 0.8 to every Test claim sharing an evidence page
normalized claim not repeating an earlier sampled claim

roles.held_out: checked once after the analysis is frozen

model: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct NF4 (rev a09a354), greedy, 64 output tokens; the product's shared generator

conditions.C0: no evidence; team closed-book FEVER prompt (baselines/_lib/prompts.py build_fever_closed_book_prompt at e8c4213)
conditions.C1: BGE IVFPQ (nprobe 16) Top-5 FEVER pages from the accepted FEVER backend; build_fever_rag_prompt
conditions.L1: P3-20 for FEVER on every item: the product's P320RetrievalEnhancer with enable_fever (Top-20, CPU cross-encoder, RRF, FEVER prompt; an unparsable label keeps C1)
conditions.L3: one evidence block of the gold sentences (union, annotation order, space-joined) first, then C1's Top-5 pages without evidence pages, first four; build_fever_rag_prompt
conditions.L4: the gold sentence block alone; build_fever_rag_prompt
conditions.truncation: none beyond the C1 path's own; prompt token counts are recorded

data_exception: L3 / L4 put gold evidence sentences into prompts (oracle upper bound), on FEVER-train items only
label_parsing: src.evaluation.fever.parse_fever_prediction (first SUPPORTS/REFUTES token); UNKNOWN counts as wrong
metrics: accuracy per condition, overall and per gold label
RFR_a = #{C1 wrong and condition a correct} / #{C1 wrong}, each condition on its own (L3 and L4 are not assumed monotone)
wrong->correct and correct->wrong against C1 per condition
complete gold evidence page coverage in C1 Top-5 and in the P3 Top-5
cost: generations, prompt tokens and seconds per condition
smoke: 20 development items through every condition before the full run; checks sentence mapping, prompts and parsing
comparison: with the NQ ladder (configs/controller/recoverability_oracle_v1.json): RFR per level, persistent failures at L4; absolute accuracies are not compared across tasks
